name: Example Duel
description: An example of a scenario file: two X-wings and a Y-wing with a gunner against three TIE fighters.
Copy this file, change the forces and give it a new name to make a scenario of your own.
_help: Lines starting with _ (like this one) are notes for you: the game ignores them. Only name, description, map and sides are used.
map: 'static' (fixed edges) or 'adjustable' (the map grows as the ships move). Each side needs a faction ('rebels' or 'empire') and a list of ships.
A ship is { "typeId": ..., "quality": ... }. Optional: "gunners": [qualities] (one entry per gunner), "tag": a name for the ship, "reserve": a name (the ship waits off the map and enters later).
Every scenario needs at least one ship on each side.
_shipTypes: Empire: tie-fighter, tie-interceptor, tie-interceptor-prototype, tie-bomber, imperial-shuttle (1 gunner), star-destroyer (capital ship, Empire only)
Rebels: x-wing, y-wing-1seat, y-wing-2seat (1 gunner), a-wing, b-wing, mon-calamari (capital ship, Rebels only)
Either side: stock-freighter (2 gunners), millennium-falcon (2 gunners), slave-i, pirate-pinnace, nebulon-b (capital ship)
Capital ships have no pilot: leave out the quality and, if you like, give them a gunnery skill, e.g. { "typeId": "star-destroyer", "skill": { "dice": 5, "pips": 0 } }
_qualities: trainee, poor, average, veteran, hotshot (worst to best). Use them for pilots and for gunners.
_gunnerExample: A ship with a gunner (the y-wing-2seat below): { "typeId": "y-wing-2seat", "quality": "veteran", "gunners": ["average"] }
The pilot is the 'quality'; the gunners come in the list, one quality per gunner seat. A ship with two seats (freighter, Falcon) takes two entries: "gunners": ["average", "poor"].
